readings: z is a combinational Moore output of the current state, updating in the same cycle as the state.
z is a registered output updated on the positive clock edge, so it is delayed by one cycle relative to the state.
Reset does not affect z; z continues to reflect the current state even while reset is asserted.
z is forced to 0 (or to A's output) whenever reset is asserted, regardless of the current state.
Unused state codes are unspecified; the FSM may produce undefined z and next state for them.
Unused state codes are explicitly handled by defaulting to state A with z=0.
The state register has no specified power-up value; it is X until reset is applied.
The state register is initialized to state A at power-up (e.g., via initial block).
